  • Method Details

    • play

      void play(CutsceneScript script, Runnable onFinished)
      Starts the cutscene. onFinished must be called exactly once, whether the cutscene ran to the end, was stopped, or could not be played at all.

    • stop

      void stop()
      Ends the running cutscene early, hiding the video. Calls onFinished.
